item.title: Emmett Corrigan’s Killer Said He Couldn’t Remember The Shooting
item.description: Idaho attorney Emmett Corrigan was killed outside a Walgreens in 2011 by his paralegal’s husband, Robert Hall. Hall suffered a head wound and reported memory loss, but jurors convicted him of second-degree murder. He received 30 years, with parole eligibility after 17½.

item.title: Crystal Rogers’s Boyfriend Was Convicted Without Her Body
item.description: Kentucky mother of five Crystal Rogers vanished in July 2015. A decade later, her boyfriend, Brooks Houck, was convicted of murder and evidence tampering and sentenced to life in prison. He is appealing his conviction, while her remains have never been found.

item.title: Savanna Greywind Vanished. Her Baby Was Found Upstairs
item.description: Savanna LaFontaine-Greywind, 22, disappeared in Fargo, North Dakota, in August 2017. Police found her newborn alive in an upstairs neighbor’s apartment; Savanna’s body was later recovered from the Red River. Brooke Crews pleaded guilty and received life without parole.

item.title: Anna Delvey’s Heiress Persona Hid A Fortune That Didn’t Exist
item.description: Anna Sorokin used the name Anna Delvey and a fictitious overseas fortune to persuade banks and hotels to extend her credit. Convicted of grand larceny, attempted grand larceny and theft of services in 2019, she was sentenced to four to 12 years in prison.

item.title: Heather Elvis’s Kidnappers Were Convicted. She’s Still Missing
item.description: Heather Elvis, 20, disappeared near Myrtle Beach, South Carolina, in December 2013. Sidney and Tammy Moorer were convicted of kidnapping her and each sentenced to 30 years in prison. Despite those convictions, Heather has never been found.

item.title: Police Suspected Keith Dardeen Until They Found Him Dead
item.description: When Elaine Dardeen and her two children were found murdered in their Illinois home in 1987, police initially suspected her missing husband, Keith. His body was discovered a mile away the next day. No one has been convicted of the family’s killings.
